z-m-04-01.title: Ikhadi elilandelayo elitsalwayo lingaba lini?
z-m-04-01.goal: Ngalo lonke ixesha ikhadi likhutshwa, lungisa uthethe 'inokuvela / ayinakuvela / kufuneka ivele' ngesizathu.
z-m-04-01.material: Ebhokisini kukho amakhadi amanani ama-6, abhalwe 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, kunye no-6, elinye ngalinye. Umva wamakhadi onke uyafana, ngoko utsala elinye ngexesha ngamehlo evaliwe. Emva kokuhlola ukhadi elitsalwe ngaphambili, ulibeka ecaleni kwaye awulibuyiseli ebhokisini. Izaziso ezingezantsi ziyavulwa elinye ngexesha.
z-m-04-01.thinking.2: Ukuthandabuza izizathu ezivakala zinengqiqo ezifana nobukhulu okanye ulandelelwano
z-m-04-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi amanani asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10 nokwahlula angaqhelekanga naqhelekileyo (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-04-01.s.s1.prompt: Izaziso ziyavulwa elinye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha ingxelo echanekileyo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisaziso ngasinye, kuqala bhala 'ngawaphi amakhadi asele ebhokisini ngoku'.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ingxelo oyikhethileyo ichanekile ngokwenene ngokusebenza, kwikhadi ngalinye elisele, ukuba linokuvela na.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Akukho kadi litsalwe okwangoku. Cinga ngekhadi lokuqala oza kulitsala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Lonke ikhadi elisebhokisini linokuvela, kwaye ikhadi elingekho ebhokisini, njenge-7, alinakuvela. Awukwazi ukugqiba kwangaphambili ukuba lingeliphi ikhadi eliza kuvela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubonile ukuba kukho i-5 ebhokisini, ngoko inokuvela. Kuyingcinga elungileyo ukujonga amakhadi akhoyo kuqala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ebhokisini kukho amakhadi 1 ukuya kwi-6 kuphela. Phinda ujonge ukuba ikhadi elingekho ebhokisini linokuvela na.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuba utsala ngamehlo evaliwe, awukwazi ukugqiba kwangaphambili ukuba liliphi ikhadi eliza kuba lilo. 'Inokuvela' no-'kufuneka ivele' zahlukile.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ikhadi eliza kuvela lelinye le-1 ukuya kwi-6
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uhambe phezu kwamakhadi onke asebhokisini wathi uluhlu lwento enokuvela. Awuzange ugqibe ukuba linani lini.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Utsale amakhadi amabini wafumana i-5 ne-2. Ubeke amakhadi amabini ecaleni kwaye awuwabuyiselanga ebhokisini. Ngoku cinga ngekhadi lesithathu eliza kulitsala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.after: I-5 ne-2 zihambile ebhokisini kwaye aziyi kubuya. Ngoko i-5 ayisakwazi ukuvela, kwaye amakhadi aseleyo 1, 3, 4, kunye ne-6 onke anokuvela. Ulwazi olutsha lutshintshe ingcinga enye yezokuqala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ucinge imeko njengoko yayiyiyo ekuqaleni. Jonga ukuba i-5 ikuphi ngoku.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-5 ne-2 zivele, ngoko ngeli xesha lixesha le-1 ngolandelelwano
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Akukho 'xesha' lilungisiweyo. Ukuba utsala ngamehlo evaliwe, onke amakhadi aseleyo anokuvela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ujonge kuphela amakhadi asele ebhokisini, ushiya amakhadi abekwe ecaleni. Usebenzise ulwazi olutsha kwisigwebo sakho.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: I-5 ne-2 sele zivele, ngoko ngeli xesha i-6 kufuneka ivele
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ngenxa yokuba amanye amakhadi sele evele, ikhadi elilandelayo alinqunywanga. Jonga ukuba mangaphi amakhadi asele.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.info: I-4 ivele njengekhadi lesithathu. Ubeke i-4 ecaleni nayo. Ngoku amakhadi amathathu, 1, 3, kunye ne-6, asele ebhokisini.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Khetha ingxelo echanekileyo malunga nekhadi lesine eliza kulitsala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Phakathi kwamakhadi aseleyo 1, 3, 6, kukho angaqhelekanga (1, 3) naqhelekileyo (6). Ngoko omabini anokuvela. Nangona kukho amakhadi ambalwa, kusenyanisile ukuba awukwazi ukugqiba kwangaphambili ukuba liliphi ikhadi eliza kuvela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba likho na inani eliqhelekileyo phakathi kwamakhadi aseleyo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: I-6 lelona nani likhulu, ngoko i-6 inamathuba amakhulu okuvela
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Inani elikhulu alitsalwa lula. Umva wamakhadi onke uyafana kwaye utsala ngamehlo evaliwe.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: I-4 ibekwe ecaleni. Hlola ukuba i-4 ikhona na ebhokisini ngoku.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ubone into yokuba kukho amanani angaqhelekanga naqhelekileyo phakathi kwe-1, 3, 6 eseleyo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.reflect: Uluvo lwakho lokuba i-5 inokuvela lutshintshe njani emva kokuba i-5 ibekwe ecaleni? Kwaye yeyiphi ingxelo ehleliyo injalo nasemva kokutsalwa kwamakhadi amaninzi?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo wathi, "Amakhadi aseleyo 1, 3, kunye ne-6, ngoko elona likhulu, i-6, liza kuvela!" Ungathanda ukuthi ntoni kulo mhlobo?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba kulungile na ukutshintsha "liza kuvela" emazwini omhlobo wakho libe "linokuvela".
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenza ukuba akunakwenzeka ngokwenene ukuba ikhadi elingeyiyo i-6 livele phakathi kwamakhadi amathathu aseleyo.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umahluko phakathi kwe-'inokuvela' kunye ne-'kufuneka ivele' uyabonakala koko ndikuthethileyo?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ngenyaniso yokuba amanye amakhadi phakathi kwe-1, 3, 6 aseleyo nawo anokuvela?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.0: I-6 inokuvela, kodwa ayinyanzelekanga. I-1 okanye i-3 zinokuvela.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.1: Inani elikhulu alivela lula. Utsala ngamehlo evaliwe, ngoko awukwazi ukwazi ukuba liliphi ikhadi eliza kuvela.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.2: I-6 inokuphuma, kodwa hayi ngokuqinisekileyo. I-1 okanye i-3 zinokuphuma nazo.

z-m-04-03.title: Ibala ligquma ibhokisi enye
z-m-04-03.topic: Idatha efihliweyo kwitheyibhile: yintoni enye esiyifunayo ukuyifumana?
z-m-04-03.goal: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumanisa ibhokisi enye yetheyibhile (inani elipheleleyo, ukuba umntu ngamnye ukhethe into enye kuphela), uze uthi impendulo itshintsha njani xa ulwazi olutsha lufika.
z-m-04-03.material: Abahlobo kwiklasi yethu bakhetha ngamnye uhlobo olunye lwesithuthi abalubuthandayo. Upende ufake kwibhokisi enye yetheyibhile yophando, ngoko ayibonakali. [Itheyibhile] Imoto 6 / Uloliwe □ (ayibonakali) / Inqwelomoya 4 / Inqanawa 2. Ufuna ukwazi inani elingena kwibhokisi engenanto (□).
z-m-04-03.thinking.2: Ukulungisa isigqibo sakho ngokufaka ulwazi olutsha
z-m-04-03.prereq.0: Ukudibanisa nokususa amanani ukuya kutsho kwi-20 (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-04-03.prereq.1: Ukufunda inani labantu kwibhokisi nganye yetheyibhile
z-m-04-03.s.s1.prompt: Yintoni enye ekufuneka uyazi ukufumana inani elingena kwi-□? Khetha zonke ezilungileyo.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ujonge onke amanani kwiibhokisi ezaziwayo kwitheyibhile.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba elo nani kufuneka lunxulumane njani nayo yonke iklasi.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.a: Ngowuphi umbutho aphantsi kuwo abo ba-4 abakhetha inqwelomoya
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba ngubani ophi umbutho akunamsebenzi nenani elikwi-□. Jonga kwakhona ulwazi oluyafuneka ukuze umisele inani.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukuphakama akunamsebenzi nenani elikwi-□. Cinga ukuba ngulwazi olunjani olwaluza kukuvumela umisele inani.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.c: Ufune ukulinganisa isixa setheyibhile namabhokisi aziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.d: Ingaba amanani kumasele amathathu aziwayo (imoto, inqwelomoya, inqanawa) alungile
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.d: Amanani kumasele aziwayo sele akwitheyibhile. Ukumisela i-□, kufuneka ulwazi olungekho kwitheyibhile.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.e: Ingaba umntu ngamnye ukhethe into enye kuphela
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.e: Uzamile ukujonga ukuba akukho mntu ovela kwiibhokisi ezimbini.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba uyazi inani elipheleleyo labantu ebeklasini nokuba umntu ngamnye ukhethe into enye kuphela, inani eliseleyo emva kokususa amasele amathathu aziwayo yi-□. Ukwazi ukuphakama okanye igama lomhlobo okhethe uloliwe, okanye ukujonga nje kwakhona amasele aziwayo, akukwazi ukumisela i-□.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.prompt: Utitshala wakuxelela. "Siyi-15 kwiklasi yethu. Umhlobo omnye akabikho namhlanje, ngoko asinakumcazulula. Wonke umhlobo ocazululwe ukhethe into enye kuphela." Yimangaphi i-□?
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.0: Umhlobo ongabikhoyo akavelanga naphi na kwitheyibhile. Qala unqume ukuba bangaphi abantu abafuneka bavele kwitheyibhile.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa elo nani namanani kwiibhokisi ezintathu ezaziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.a: Kubonakala ngathi usebenzise yonke iklasi yabantu abali-15 njengoko injalo. Jonga ulwazi lokuba kukho umhlobo ongazange acazululwe.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.b: Ngoku uyazi inani elipheleleyo labantu nokuba ngamnye ukhethe into enye kuphela. Jonga kwakhona ukuba olo lwazi lukuvumela ukumisela i-□.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.c: Ulinganise iibhokisi ezaziwayo nenani labantu abacazululweyo. Usebenzise ulwazi lokuba umhlobo akabikho.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.d: Jonga oko ukushiyileyo ngoxa ubala amanani kwiibhokisi ezaziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.explain: Abahlobo abacazululweyo ngabali-14, oko kukuthi ali-15 ukususa u-1 ongabikhoyo. Iibhokisi ezaziwayo zi-6 + 4 + 2 = 12, ngoko i-□ yi-14 − 12 = 2.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba omnye umhlobo ebengabikhoyo, bebeya kuba bangaphi abahlobo abakhetha uloliwe? Bhala ukuba waziwa njani.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.0: Funda kwakhona ukuba lingakanani inani eliphelele owalisebenzisa ngoku ukufumana i-□.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.1: Qala uthi kwenzeka ntoni kwelo nani liphelele ukuba omnye umhlobo akabikho.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba amanani endiwabhalileyo asebenzise omabini amanani kwiibhokisi ezintathu ezaziwayo nenani labantu abacazululweyo?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uchazile ukuba kutheni i-□ kuphela etshintshayo, hayi ezinye iibhokisi, xa omnye umhlobo engabikhoyo?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.0: 1. Abahlobo abacazululweyo bayehla ngomnye baye kwi-13, ngoko emva kokudibanisa ezaziwayo ezi-6, 4, nezi-2, okusalayo yi-1.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.modelNote.0: Kuchazwe nge-13 ukususa i-12 ebaliweyo kuwo onke amabhokisi aziwayo, inani eliseleyo
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.1: Nye. Isixa siyehle ngenye kodwa ezinye iibhokisi ziyahlala, ngoko ibhokisi yololiwe iyehla ngenye.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.2: Umntu o-1. Inani labantu abacazululweyo liba li-13 kwaye amasele aziwayo ali-12, ngoko 13-12=1.

z-m-04-02.title: Xa ndibala, amanani abahlobo ababini ayahluka
z-m-04-02.topic: Ukubala ngaphandle kokushiya nanye: ukufumana apho ukubala kwahamba gwenxa khona
z-m-04-02.goal: Xa ukubala kwabantuababini kwahlukile, sebenzisa inani kumgca ngamnye njengobungqina, ufunde ukuba akukho namnye onokuba unyanisile, ufumane impazamo uze uthi indlela yokubala evimbela impazamo efanayo.
z-m-04-02.material: Etafileni kukho izitikha ezifanayo zenkwenkwezi kwimigca emithathu. Umgca ongaphezulu unezi-5, umgca ophakathi unezi-6, kwaye umgca ongezantsi unezi-5. U-Jihu no-Nari babala ukuba zingaphi izitikha zonke. U-Jihu wathi zili-15, kwaye u-Nari wathi zili-17. Ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba ngowuphi kubahlobo ababini ongunyanisile.
z-m-04-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ngobungqina (inani kumgca ngamnye) xa iziphumo zahlukile
z-m-04-02.thinking.2: Ukucinga ngeendlela zokuthintela ukuphoswa nokubala kabini
z-m-04-02.prereq.0: Ukubala amanani ukuya kutsho kwi-20 ngolandelelwano (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-04-02.s.s1.prompt: Jonga amanani abahlobo ababini ababalile ukhethe ingxelo elungileyo.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba zingaphi kumgca ngamnye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba isixa sokubala imigca emithathu sifana namanani abahlobo ababini ababalile.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.a: Inani elincinci alilunganga ngokuqinisekileyo. Jonga ukuba kwenzeka ntoni xa udibanisa amanani omgca ngamnye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.b: Uhlole omabini amanani usebenzisa inani kumgca ngamnye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ukuba lowo ubale ngaphezulu akazange aphose nanye. Kodwa unokubala isitikha esifanayo kabini nawe.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.d: Inani kumgca ngamnye sele lisaziwa. Jonga kwakhona ukuba ungahlola ngalo na.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba ubala umgca ongaphezulu i-5, umgca ophakathi i-6, nomgca ongezantsi i-5, zili-16. Akukho nanye kwezi-15 awazibalayo u-Jihu okanye ezi-17 awazibalayo u-Nari elilungileyo. Bobabini abahlobo benze impazamo kwindawo ethile ngoxa babala.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngolu hlobo u-Jihu wabala ngokuvakalayo. Khetha umgca ongalunganga.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ukuba zingaphi ezibaliweyo kumgca ngamnye uzithelekise nenani elaziwayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kumagama asetyenziselwa ukubala umgca ongezantsi, khomba ngomnwe ubone ukuba zingaphi ezibaliweyo.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.0: Wabala umgca ongaphezulu ukusuka ekhohlo: nye, mbini, ntathu, ne, hlanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.1: Wabala umgca ophakathi ukusuka ekhohlo, eqhubeka: thandathu, sixhenxe, sibhozo, lithoba, lishumi, elinanye.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.2: Wabala umgca ongezantsi ukusuka ekhohlo, eqhubeka: elinambini, elinantathu, elinane, elinahlanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.3: Inani lokugqibela elibaliweyo lelinahlanu, ngoko zili-15 zonke.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.explain: Umgca 3 awulunganga. Umgca ongezantsi unezitikha ezi-5, kodwa wabala ezi-4 kuphela: elinambini, elinantathu, elinane, elinahlanu. Elinesithandathu liphoswe. Imigca 1 no-2 yabalwa ukuze ihambelane nenani kumgca ngamnye, kwaye umgca 4 wavuselela inani lokugqibela elibaliweyo ngaphambili, ngoko ayiyimpazamo kwindlela yokubala ngokwayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.prompt: U-Nari wathi zili-17. Qikelela apho u-Nari anokuba ahamba gwenxa khona, ubhale indlela yokubala enokuthintela impazamo efanayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ujonge ukuba i-17 inkulu okanye incinci kune-16, uze ucinge ukuba kukho into ephoswe okanye eyabalwa ngaphezulu.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba luphawu olunjani kwezo ubalileyo olwaluza kukuthintela ukuba ubale isitikha esifanayo kabini.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba impazamo endiyiqikeleleyo ihambelana nenani li-17?
z-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ukuba ndisebenzisa indlela endiyibhalileyo, ingakuthintela zombini impazamo ka-Jihu nempazamo ka-Nari?
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.0: Kubonakala ngathi inkwenkwezi enye yabalwa kabini. Ukuba ubala ngelixa wenza uphawu oluncinci kwiinkwenkwezi ozibalileyo, awuyi kubala kabini okanye uphose nanye.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.1: Kubonakala ngathi enye yabalwa kwakhona phakathi komgca ophakathi nomgca ongezantsi. Ukuba ubala umgca ngamnye ngokwahlukileyo uze uwubhale, emva koko udibanise, ungafumana umgca ongalunganga.

z-m-04-04.title: Ingaba 'eyona inkulu' ihlala iphumelela zonke ezinye?
z-m-04-04.topic: Ukwenza umzekelo ochasayo: ukuthelekisa into ekhethwe kakhulu nazo zonke ezinye zidibene
z-m-04-04.goal: Yenza itheyibhile apho isibango esithi 'umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu uhlala unabantu abaninzi kunabo bonke abanye bedibene' singalunganga, uze uthi umqathango ophantsi kwawo isibango siba lulungile.
z-m-04-04.material: Abahlobo abali-12 bakhetha umsebenzi abafuna ukuwenza kwipikniki. Imisebenzi kukuzingela ubutyebi, ukutsiba intambo, nemidlalo yebhola. Bonke abali-12 bakhetha into enye kuphela. U-Hayun wathi, "Umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu uhlala unabahlobo abaninzi kunabahlobo abakhethe eminye imisebenzi emibini bedibene!" Cinga ukuba ukho umsebenzi omnye kuphela okhethwe kakhulu, kwaye awulingani nomnye umsebenzi.
z-m-04-04.thinking.0: Ukwenza umzekelo ochasayo kwisibango se-'ngalo lonke ixesha'
z-m-04-04.thinking.2: Ukufumana umqathango ophantsi kwawo isibango silungile
z-m-04-04.prereq.0: Ukudibanisa amanani ukuya kutsho kwi-12 (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-04-04.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba isibango sika-Hayun sihlala silungile? Phambi kokwenza itheyibhile, khetha ingcinga yakho.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka inani elincinci elinye ubhale imeko enye.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.1: Beka cala ngecala inani lomsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu nenani olifumana ngokudibanisa eminye imisebenzi emibini.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.a: Ihlala ilunge. Umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu unabantu abaninzi kunayo eminye imisebenzi
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.a: 'Ngaphezu kwenye imisebenzi nganye' kunye 'ngaphezu kwayo yonke eseleyo idibene' akuthethi into enye.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.b: Ayibonakali ihlala ilunge. Ndiza kuyivavanya ngokufaka amanani
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.b: Ubonile ukuba isibango sithi 'ngalo lonke ixesha', ngoko kufanelekile ukuyivavanya. Yimeko yokuhlola ngamanani.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.c: Andazi. Asikwazi ukuxela kuba bangabantu abali-12
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.c: Inani labantu limisiwe. Cinga ukuba ungafumanisa ngokufaka inani na.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.explain: Igama elithi 'ngalo lonke ixesha' lingaphulwa ngomzekelo omnye nje. Unokufumanisa ngokuvavanya ngetheyibhile oyenzayo wena. Umfundi othe 'andazi' ekuqaleni unokugweba emva kokwenza itheyibhile.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.acc.0: Ekuqaleni usenokungazi. Unokufumanisa ngokwenza itheyibhile uvavanye. Kulungile ukuba ufuna ukuyivavanya.

z-m-04-06.s.s1.o.b: Bala bonke abahlobo abakhethe ingane yenja nekati kunye
z-m-04-06.s.s1.r.b: Inani elibaliweyo lilonke linani lilonke labahlobo abaphandiweyo. Sebenza ukuba linani elithi 'zingaphi ezininzi ngakumbi' na.

z-m-04-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuba uzidibanisa, i-○ ezi-3 ziyasala. Ukubala umva ukusuka kwisi-8 ukuya kwesi-5 nako kumanyathelo ama-3. Iimpendulo zeendlela ezimbini ziyafana, abahlobo aba-3. Inani elibaliweyo lilonke, i-13, okanye inani elikhulu, isi-8, asingo 'zingaphi ezininzi ngakumbi'.

z-m-04-06.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola ukuba amanani amabini adityaniswe abahlobo abali-15 okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Amanani abahlobo ngamanani emvelo yaye umhlobo o-1 ubuncinane ukhethe ikati.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Amanani abahlobo kufuneka abe ngamanani emvelo, yaye umhlobo o-1 ubuncinane kufuneka abe ekhethe ikati.

z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kufuneka abahlobo aba-3 kanye abakhethe ingane yenja ngaphezu kwabakhethe ikati.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Nokuba badityaniswe, abo bombini bayi-15 abahlobo okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Abahlobo abakhethe izilwanyana ezimbini kufuneka badibane babe li-15 okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.explain: Ukuba umhlobo o-1 ukhethe ikati, ingane yenja yi-4; ukuba kuyi-5, ngoko yi-8; ukuba kuyi-6, ngoko yi-9. Kuzo zonke iimeko, ukuba udibanisa i-○ ne-△, i-○ ezi-3 ziyasala. Isixa kufuneka sibe li-15 okanye ngaphantsi, ngoko inani labahlobo abakhethe ikati lingaba ngu-6 ubuninzi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Nokuba amanani abahlobo abakhethe ingane yenja nekati ahluke kwitafile nganye, kusenyani ukuba 'kukho abahlobo aba-3 abaninzi bengane yenja kunekati'. Bhala isizathu ngamazwi asebenzisa ukudibanisa i-○ ne-△.

z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Emva kokudibanisa, bala i-○ engenasiqhagamshelanisi kuzo zombini iitafile uze uzithelekise.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthe zingaphi i-○ ezisalayo emva kokudibanisa?
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucacise kutheni inani le-○ ezisalayo lihlala linjalo nokuba abahlobo abaninzi ngakumbi bakhetha ikati?
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba udibanisa i-○ ne-△ enye ngenye, kuyo nayiphi na itafile i-○ ezi-3 ezingenasiqhagamshelanisi ziyasala. Nokuba zombini zikhula ngomlinganiselo ofanayo, oko kusalayo kuhlala kungu-3.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Inani elisalayo emva kokudibanisa lihlala linjalo
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba umhlobo o-1 ongezelelweyo ukhetha ikati, umhlobo o-1 ongezelelweyo ukhetha ingane yenja nawo, ngoko emva kokudibanisa, i-○ esalayo isengu-3.

z-m-04-07.title: Kwakukho iintsuku ezininzi zelanga kule veki, ingaba iveki ezayo iya kuba njalo nayo?
z-m-04-07.topic: Oko iirekhodi zinokukuxela nezingakuxeli: ukuqikelela into eya kwenzeka okulandelayo
z-m-04-07.goal: Funda ukuba ukusuka kwiirekhodi zangaphambili unokuthi yintoni eyayiyeyona 'ininzi', kodwa awunakubanga ngokuqinisekileyo oko kuza kwenzeka okulandelayo, uze uthi uqikelelo lwakho lutshintsha njani ukuba unamarekhodi amaninzi ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.material: Warekhoda imozulu kwikhalenda yegumbi lokufundela iintsuku ezi-5, uMsombuluko ukuya kuLwesihlanu. Kule veki kwakukho iintsuku ezi-3 zelanga, usuku olu-1 olunamafu, nosuku olu-1 olunemvula. UYeonseo wathi, "Kwakukho iintsuku zelanga ezininzi kakhulu kule veki, ngoko iveki ezayo kuya kubakho iintsuku zelanga ezininzi kakhulu nazo."
z-m-04-07.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko iirekhodi zinokukuthetha nokungakwazi ukukuthetha
z-m-04-07.thinking.1: Ukulungisa indlela oqiniseke ngayo njengoko idatha ikhula
z-m-04-07.prereq.0: Ukudibanisa amanani ukuya kwesi-5 nokufunda inani leentsuku etafileni (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-04-07.prereq.1: Amagama emozulu anje ngelanga, amafu, imvula
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba inyaniso yokuba iintsuku zelanga zazininzi kakhulu kwirekhodi yale veki nemozulu yeveki ezayo yintetho enye na.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ibiya kwahluka njani ukuba bekukho iirekhodi zemozulu zezinye iiveki.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise iirekhodi zangaphambili njengesalathiso kodwa awubonakalisanga isigqibo. Unokucinga ukuba izinto zingatshintsha njani ukuba bekukho iirekhodi ezininzi ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.b: Iirekhodi zale veki azisixeleli nto ngeveki ezayo
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.b: Iirekhodi zale veki azimiseli iveki ezayo, kodwa kuyihlazo ukuthi akukho salathiso konke. Isalathiso nokuqiniseka zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.c: Bekunjalo kule veki, ngoko iveki ezayo iya kuba njalo ngokuqinisekileyo nayo
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.c: Uthwale irekhodi leveki enye ngqo waya kwiveki ezayo. Ezinye iiveki zisenokuba zahlukile.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.explain: Irekhodi yale veki sisalathiso sokuba kunokubakho iintsuku zelanga ezininzi iveki ezayo. Kodwa ngerekhodi yeveki e-1 kuphela, awukwazi ukuthi 'ngokuqinisekileyo' kuya kuba njalo.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.acc.0: Ubone kakuhle ukuba irekhodi yeveki e-1 ayinakumisela iveki ezayo. Kodwa ukuba irekhodi isebenza njengesalathiso kunokusetyenzwa ngoxa kuqokelelwa ezininzi.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.prompt: UYeonseo wafumana nerekhodi yeveki ephelileyo. Iveki ephelileyo yayineentsuku ezi-2 zelanga, usuku olu-1 olunamafu, neentsuku ezi-2 ezinemvula. Xa ufaka iiveki ezimbini (iintsuku ezili-10) kunye, kukho iintsuku ezi-5 zelanga, iintsuku ezi-2 ezinamafu, neentsuku ezi-3 ezinemvula. Khetha intetho elungileyo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bala iintsuku zeeveki ezimbini kwakhona ngemozulu uze uzibhale etafileni.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ngokwahlukileyo oko ungakuthetha ukusuka kwiirekhodi noko ungakwaziyo ngeveki ezayo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.a: Iintsuku zelanga zazininzi kakhulu, ngoko iveki ezayo kuya kubakho iintsuku zelanga ezininzi kakhulu ngokuqinisekileyo nazo
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba uqokelele iirekhodi zeentsuku ezili-10, iveki ezayo ayikafiki. Okukhona uqokelela, kokukhona unesalathiso, kodwa awukwazi ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.b: Iintsuku zelanga zazininzi kakhulu, kodwa asikwazi ukwazi ngeveki ezayo
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.b: Wahlule oko iirekhodi zinokusixelela (kwakuyeyona ininzi) koko zingakwazi (iveki ezayo).
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.c: Kwakukho iintsuku ezinemvula ezininzi kuneentsuku zelanga
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.c: Thelekisa kwakhona iintsuku ezi-5 zelanga neentsuku ezi-3 ezinemvula.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.d: Siqokelele iintsuku ezili-10, ngoko iveki ezayo kuya kubakho iintsuku ezi-3 zelanga kanye
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.d: Uthwale umlinganiselo wamarekhodi angaphambili ngqo waya kwiveki ezayo. Nokuba iirekhodi ziyakhula, awukwazi ukumisela inani elichanekileyo leentsuku zeveki ezayo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.explain: Kwirekhodi yeentsuku ezili-10, unokuthi iintsuku zelanga zazininzi kakhulu, ngeentsuku ezi-5. Kodwa imozulu yeveki ezayo ayikenzeki, ngoko ayinakumiselwa. Njengoko iirekhodi ziyakhula, isalathiso sokuba kunokubakho iintsuku zelanga ezininzi siba nokukholeleka kancinci ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala oko ungakuthetha ngemozulu yeveki ezayo ngedatha oyinayo ngoku, noko kungekaqiniseki. Bhala nokuba ziziphi ezinye iirekhodi ezinokukwenza uthembe loo ntetho ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga ukuba iiveki ezineentsuku zelanga ezininzi kakhulu zazifana kwiirekhodi zale veki nezeveki ephelileyo.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ungafunda ntoni ngakumbi ukuba uqokelela uhlobo olufanayo lwerekhodi iiveki ezimbalwa ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kwinto endiyithetheyo, ingaba 'oko sinokukwazi ngedatha yangoku' 'nento esingayaziyo okwangoku' zahlulwe?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba iirekhodi endithe mazaqokelelwe ngakumbi ziya kunceda ekuqikeleleni imozulu yeveki ezayo?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.0: Iintsuku zelanga zisenokuba zininzi kakhulu, kodwa hayi ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukuba siqokelela iirekhodi zeeveki ezininzi ngakumbi, singathembela ngakumbi.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.1: Asikwazi ukwazi okwangoku. Iiveki ezimbini kuphela azonelanga, ngoko kufuneka siqokelele iirekhodi zezinye iiveki size sibone ukuba zingaphi izihlandlo iintsuku zelanga ezazininzi kakhulu.
